name: ytube-downloader
description: YouTube downloader backend and frontend monorepo

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend && cd frontend && npx vite build && cd .. && mkdir -p backend/dist && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/dist/ && npm install --prefix backend && cd backend && (if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp_macos -o yt-dlp; else curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp_linux -o yt-dlp; fi) && chmod a+rx yt-dlp
